messages:
Alice M.: Kicking off orbit rollout handoff. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC, staggered slices, 10m smoke windows. Pinning version r2026-03-21a to canary.
DeployBot: Deploy initiated: slice=orbit-3 region=us-west seq=1 version=r2026-03-21a canary=2% handlers=default
Raj P.: Ack. Infra-SRE, please confirm thermal cushion/headroom for us-west? current GPU pool util at ~68% overall.
Infra-SRE: us-west GPU pool headroom ~28%. Thermal cushion OK for a 2% canary but watch p99 latency. Warming +2 GPUs into warm-pool now.
Sophie L.: Added orbit-3 to warm pool, autoscaler min increased by 2 for next 15m.
Jin K.: Quick Q — is the fallback model pinned? we want fallback to light-quant v1 if we hit thermal/latency thresholds.
Alice M.: Yes fallback pinned to v1-light-quant. Policy: auto-failover -> route degrade then pin-route to fallback if sustained overload.
DeployBot: Canary traffic ramped to 2% at 1767654326
Raj P.: Observability readout: p50=45ms p95=220ms p99=520ms, error rate=0.0% for canary nodes. No CPU/GPU throttles seen yet.
Sophie L.: Starting 15m smoke window. Rollback criteria (agreed): p99 > 900ms sustained 3m OR error rate > 0.5% sustained 1m OR user-facing 5xx spike.
Alice M.: Copy. Ramp plan: hold 2% for 15m -> bump 10% wait 10m -> 30% wait 15m -> full slice.
Jin K.: Noted. Scheduling EU warmup start at ~1767654680 (+~7m).
Infra-SRE: EU pool headroom ~18% — pre-warming 3 GPUs now. APAC pool headroom low (~8%); recommend holding APAC until after EU ramp.
DeployBot: Canary elevated to 10% at 1767654390
Raj P.: Small p95 spike: jumped to 380ms for ~30s at 1767654395, no errors. Root cause -> KV cache warming/prefix miss on a subset of nodes.
Sophie L.: Expected behavior on initial traffic increase. Monitoring KV cache hit-rate; will log if it persists.
Alice M.: Decision: continue rollout. If we see repeated p95/p99 spikes or any error > rollback threshold, trigger immediate rollback to previous pinned release (release-2026-03-19).
Jin K.: Prepared rollback script, staging it now. Pin/route rollback snippet:
```
route set --model core-gpt --from version=r2026-03-21a --to version=release-2026-03-19 --drain=30s
```
DeployBot: EU warmup triggered at 1767654685, slice=orbit-3 region=eu-central warming 3 GPUs
Infra-SRE: APAC remains on hold; attempted warm but quota exhausted in ap-southeast-1 — quota request submitted, ETA ~4h unless we approve burst in other zones.
Alice M.: OK proceed US -> EU as planned, then pause 30m before APAC decision. Update release notes with pin + fallback + rollback criteria.
Sophie L.: Added short note in #release-notes and tagged @support and @oncall for visibility. Also attached the rollback snippet.
Alice M.: Thanks team. Will post final go/no-go for APAC after EU stabilizes. :thumbsup:
